name: Gatekeeper: Pre-Execution Security for Physical AI
thesis: Capability proposes. Authority decides. Execution follows authority, not capability.
problem: Physical-AI systems can compress perception, planning and action into a machine-speed loop without an independent answer to whether this exact actor, evidence and action are authorized now.
solution: Insert an independent deterministic pre-execution authority boundary between proposed action and physical effect. Optionally attach isolated, non-authoritative Tenki-derived evidence about the exact proposal before Gatekeeper evaluates it, then bind the observed result back to the authorization record.
novelty: The model and robot retain capability but do not possess execution authority. Optional derived compute may contribute evidence but cannot authorize effect. Gatekeeper independently returns ALLOW, TRANSFORM, HOLD or DENY for the exact evidence/action pair before dispatch.

mathematical_architecture.pipeline: Observe -> Propose -> Derive evidence when configured -> Project into the admissible state space -> Execute -> Prove
mathematical_architecture.discipline: The invariant constrains admissible transitions; it does not uniquely choose the optimal next action or claim GOI validation. Tenki-derived evidence is non-authoritative and does not alter this invariant.

sponsor_story: Intel supplies the physical-AI capability surface: edge execution, inference and robotics tooling. Gatekeeper supplies the independent authority surface. The demo makes Intel's contribution visible through runtime/device evidence, inference output and the physical-AI execution path rather than only listing sponsor technologies.
architecture: optional Tenki isolated derived evidence -> exact artifact binding, authority=false
proof_cases: overspeed proposal -> TRANSFORM -> only constrained replacement executes
stale evidence -> HOLD -> zero new movement
authority unavailable -> HOLD -> no actuator call
defective object evidence -> reject proposal may remain admissible and receive ALLOW
optional Tenki claim -> exact proposal artifact/effect/principal binding with authority=false before Gatekeeper

tenki_integration.contract: POST /derive with artifact_ref, artifact_sha256, requested_effect and principal; accepted claim must remain authority=false and bind exactly to those values
tenki_integration.activation: Run scripts/probe_tenki.py onsite, use observe first, promote to required only when live latency is stable inside the evidence freshness budget
